scope: Repository task catalog and local cooperative agent queue; no app runtime changes

cases: honest active-scope progress; read-only next does not reserve
cross-worktree atomic claim; resource-prefix conflicts and dependency/session exclusion
criterion evidence, progress, handoff, blocked work, stale-token fencing and completion gates
expired claims block duplication; evidenced recovery creates fresh authority
new-task intake and aliases; stale-worktree fencing; sync preserves progress and active claims
catalog update cannot rewrite live contracts
concurrent future intake preserves both additions and existing acceptance
portable restart keeps acceptance/history and strips live authority; rejects corrupt or destructive restore
explicit deferred/blocked/cancelled lifecycle and criterion invalidation

limits: Requires agents to claim, heartbeat and checkpoint; does not detect unregistered work automatically
Shared local state across linked worktrees; no implicit multi-host coordination
Saved reports are checkpoints; live ownership comes from CLI
No Rust build or app refresh needed for this repository tooling change
